source_type: Mixed: UK Parliament select committee inquiry and published report, UK Civil Aviation Authority official ATOL failure documentation
source_quality: A-level: UK Parliament BEIS Committee report, Civil Aviation Authority official materials. These are primary governmental and regulatory sources with direct documentary authority on the collapse and its causes.
contamination_notes: The UK Parliament inquiry report (HC 85) was published after the collapse and contains post-outcome findings and conclusions. The CAA ATOL failure documentation describes events that occurred after the decision date (liquidation, repatriation). These materials are used only to ground outcome.json. Input files reflect only facts known as of 2019-08-31. The collapse itself (23 September 2019), repatriation operation, inquiry findings, and final job-loss figures are all post-decision-date and excluded from input.json and 01_case_input.json.
source_limitations: Parliamentary inquiry reports reflect retrospective findings and contain causal conclusions that postdate the decision. Input files must be constructed from pre-liquidation debt, business-model, liquidity, and rescue-financing facts. Post-collapse government reports, repatriation details, and final employment impact figures belong only in outcome scoring.
